name: clear-margin-collapse
note: Margin-collapsing interacting with clearance (§9.5.2): a left float, then an in-flow block (margin-bottom 24px), then a clear:left block with margin-top 36px. The top margin collapses with the previous sibling's bottom margin (36px wins); the hypothetical border-top lands at 68px (content-relative), which is below the float's bottom (48px), so no clearance is needed and the collapsed margin stands.
